<style id="page-two-style">
#vehicleStep[hidden],#firstStep[hidden]{display:none!important}
.step-shell{width:min(1200px,calc(100% - 48px));margin:24px auto 36px}
.step-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:17px;gap:12px}
.step-back{background:white;border:1px solid #dddfea;border-radius:10px;padding:11px 17px;color:#2E2D74;font-weight:700}
.step-count{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#2E2D74}
.step-track{height:6px;background:#e3e3ed;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:24px}
.step-track>span{display:block;width:45%;height:100%;background:#F26822;border-radius:10px}
.vehicle-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.85fr 1.15fr;gap:22px}
.vehicle-aside{background:#2E2D74;border-radius:20px;padding:36px;color:white;min-height:490px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.vehicle-aside h1{font-size:36px;line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-1px;margin:22px 0 14px;color:white}
.vehicle-aside p{color:#e5e5fa;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6}
.vehicle-aside .pill{display:inline-block;width:max-content;border:1px solid #ffffff5c;border-radius:30px;padding:9px 14px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
.vehicle-summary{margin-top:auto;background:#ffffff14;border:1px solid #ffffff30;border-radius:14px;padding:19px}
.vehicle-summary small{color:#e5e5fa;display:block;margin-bottom:8px}
.vehicle-summary strong{font-size:22px}
.vehicle-form{background:white;border:1px solid #e6e6ee;border-radius:20px;padding:33px;box-shadow:0 8px 28px #25204d0b}
.vehicle-form h2{color:#2E2D74;font-size:27px;margin:0 0 7px}
.vehicle-form .intro{color:#697084;margin:0 0 25px;font-size:14px}
.vehicle-fields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:21px 16px}
.vehicle-field label{display:block;font-weight:700;color:#2E2D74;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:9px}
.vehicle-field select,.vehicle-field input{display:block;width:100%;height:51px;border:1px solid #dcdde7;border-radius:10px;padding:0 13px;background:white;color:#27283e;font-size:14px}
.vehicle-field select:focus,.vehicle-field input:focus{outline:2px solid #2E2D74;outline-offset:1px}
.vehicle-field select:disabled{background:#f6f6f8;color:#9b9ba8}
.vehicle-choice{grid-column:1/-1}
.vehicle-choice legend{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#2E2D74;margin-bottom:12px}
.vehicle-choice fieldset{border:0;padding:0;margin:0}
.choice-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
.choice-row label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;border:1px solid #e1e1e8;border-radius:11px;padding:15px 12px;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer}
.choice-row label:has(input:checked){border-color:#F26822;background:#fff4ed;color:#2E2D74}
.choice-row input{accent-color:#F26822}
.vehicle-actions{margin-top:27px}
.vehicle-actions button{width:100%;border:0;background:#F26822;color:white;font-weight:750;border-radius:11px;height:54px;font-size:16px}
.vehicle-actions button:hover{background:#d85817}
.vehicle-validation{min-height:20px;color:#bd3223;font-size:12px;margin-top:9px}
.vehicle-note{font-size:12px;color:#85899a;text-align:center}
@media(max-width:760px){.step-shell{width:calc(100% - 24px);margin-top:12px}.vehicle-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px}.vehicle-aside{min-height:0;padding:22px}.vehicle-aside h1{font-size:26px;margin:12px 0 6px}.vehicle-aside p{margin:0 0 14px}.vehicle-summary{padding:12px}.vehicle-form{padding:23px 17px}.vehicle-fields{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:16px}.vehicle-choice{grid-column:1}.vehicle-form h2{font-size:23px}}
</style>
<style id="page-three-style">
#contactStep[hidden]{display:none!important}
.contact-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.85fr 1.15fr;gap:22px}
.contact-aside{background:#2E2D74;border-radius:20px;padding:36px;color:white;min-height:480px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.contact-aside .pill{display:inline-block;border:1px solid #ffffff65;border-radius:30px;padding:9px 14px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;width:max-content}
.contact-aside h1{font-size:36px;line-height:1.14;letter-spacing:-1px;margin:22px 0 12px;color:white}
.contact-aside p{color:#e5e5fa;line-height:1.6;font-size:15px}
.contact-summary{margin-top:auto;background:#ffffff15;border:1px solid #ffffff36;border-radius:14px;padding:19px}
.contact-summary small{display:block;color:#e5e5fa;margin-bottom:8px}
.contact-summary strong{font-size:17px;line-height:1.5;display:block}
.contact-card{background:white;border:1px solid #e6e6ee;border-radius:20px;padding:33px;box-shadow:0 8px 28px #25204d0b}
.contact-card h2{font-size:27px;color:#2E2D74;margin:0 0 8px}
.contact-card .intro{color:#697084;font-size:14px;margin:0 0 24px}
.contact-fields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px}
.contact-field label{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#2E2D74;margin-bottom:8px}
.contact-field input{width:100%;height:52px;border:1px solid #dcdde7;border-radius:10px;padding:0 13px;font-size:14px}
.contact-field input:focus{outline:2px solid #2E2D74;outline-offset:1px}
.contact-field.full{grid-column:1/-1}
.phone-group{display:flex;gap:8px}.phone-code{display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0 12px;background:#f4f4f9;border:1px solid #dcdde7;border-radius:10px;color:#2E2D74;font-weight:700;font-size:13px}
.cover-choice{grid-column:1/-1}.cover-choice fieldset{border:0;padding:0;margin:0}.cover-choice legend{font-size:13px;color:#2E2D74;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:10px}.cover-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}.cover-row label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:14px;border:1px solid #e1e1e8;border-radius:10px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer}.cover-row label:has(input:checked){border-color:#F26822;background:#fff4ed}.cover-row input,.consent input{accent-color:#F26822}
.consent{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;margin:21px 0 10px;color:#555c6c;font-size:12px;line-height:1.55}.consent input{margin-top:3px;flex-shrink:0}
.contact-submit{background:#F26822;color:white;border:0;border-radius:11px;width:100%;height:54px;font-weight:750;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer}.contact-submit:hover{background:#d85817}
.contact-error{font-size:12px;color:#bd3223;min-height:20px;margin:9px 0 0}.contact-small{font-size:12px;color:#85899a;text-align:center;margin-top:4px}
.contact-success{border:1px solid #dcdde7;border-radius:14px;padding:20px;background:#f8f8fc;color:#2E2D74;line-height:1.6;margin-top:15px}
@media(max-width:760px){.contact-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px}.contact-aside{min-height:0;padding:22px}.contact-aside h1{font-size:26px;margin:12px 0}.contact-aside p{margin:0 0 14px}.contact-summary{padding:12px}.contact-card{padding:23px 17px}.contact-card h2{font-size:23px}.contact-fields{grid-template-columns:1fr}.contact-field.full,.cover-choice{grid-column:1}.cover-row{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
</style>

<style id="manufacturer-picker-fix">

#firstStep #allBrands.open{display:block!important;visibility:visible!important;opacity:1!important;position:relative;z-index:5;max-height:285px;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(46,45,116,.09)}

</style>
<style id="manufacturer-dropdown-click-fix">#firstStep .search{cursor:pointer}#firstStep #allBrands.open{display:block!important;max-height:300px;overflow-y:auto}#firstStep #allBrands.open #results{display:grid!important}#firstStep .search:focus-within{border-color:#F26822}</style><style id="brand-picker-reference-style">

#firstStep .brand-picker .allwrap{display:none;position:absolute!important;top:calc(100% - 1px);left:0;right:0;margin:0;padding:0!important;background:#fff;border:1px solid #cfd1dd;border-top:0;border-radius:0 0 10px 10px;max-height:328px!important;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;box-shadow:0 15px 24px rgba(35,36,75,.15);z-index:21}
#firstStep .brand-picker .allwrap.open{display:block!important;visibility:visible!important;opacity:1!important}
#firstStep .brand-picker .allwrap .grid{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column;gap:0!important}
#firstStep .brand-picker .allwrap .brand{display:flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;width:100%;min-height:45px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #f0f0f5;border-radius:0;padding:9px 14px;text-align:left;background:white;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:#2E2D74;gap:12px}
#firstStep .brand-picker .allwrap .brand:hover,#firstStep .brand-picker .allwrap .brand:focus-visible{background:#fff3eb;outline:0}
#firstStep .brand-picker .allwrap .brand-logo{width:28px;height:26px;flex-shrink:0}
#firstStep .brand-picker .allwrap .brand-logo:empty{display:flex}
#firstStep .brand-picker .allwrap .brand-logo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}
#firstStep .brand-picker .allwrap .empty{padding:15px}
@media(max-width:760px){#firstStep .brand-picker .allwrap{max-height:285px!important}}

const brands=["Acura", "Aito", "Alfa Romeo", "Alpine", "Arcfox", "Aston Martin", "Audi", "Avatr", "BAIC", "BAW", "Bentley", "Bestune", "BMW", "Borgward", "Brabus", "Bugatti", "BYD", "Cadillac", "Changan", "Chery", "Chevrolet", "Chrysler", "Citroen", "Cupra", "Dacia", "Daewoo", "Daihatsu", "Deepal", "Denza", "Dodge", "Dongfeng", "DS", "Exeed", "FAW", "Ferrari", "Fiat", "Fisker", "Force", "Ford", "Forthing", "GAC", "Geely", "Genesis", "GMC", "Great Wall", "Great Wall Motors", "Haval", "Holden", "Honda", "Hongqi", "Hummer", "Hyundai", "IM Motors", "INEOS", "Infiniti", "Isuzu", "JAC", "Jaecoo", "Jaguar", "Jeep", "Jetour", "Kia", "Koenigsegg", "Lamborghini", "Lancia", "Land Rover", "Leapmotor", "Lexus", "Li Auto", "Lincoln", "Lotus", "Lucid", "Lynk & Co", "Maserati", "Maxus", "Maybach", "Mazda", "McLaren", "Mercedes-Benz", "MG", "Mini", "Mitsubishi", "Neta", "Nio", "Nissan", "OMODA", "Omoda", "Opel", "Ora", "Pagani", "Peugeot", "Polestar", "Porsche", "Prodrive", "Proton", "RAM", "Renault", "Riddara", "Rivian", "Roewe", "Rolls-Royce", "Rover", "Saab", "Seat", "Seres", "Skoda", "Smart", "Soueast", "Subaru", "Suzuki", "SWM", "Tank", "Tata", "Tesla", "Toyota", "VinFast", "Volkswagen", "Volvo", "Voyah", "Wuling", "Xpeng", "Yangwang", "Zeekr", "Zenvo", "Zotye"];
const popular=['Nissan','Toyota','Honda','Mitsubishi','Ford','Hyundai'];
const officialMarks={Nissan:'nissan/C3002F',Toyota:'toyota/EB0A1E',Honda:'honda/E40521',Mitsubishi:'mitsubishi/E60012',Ford:'ford/00274E',Hyundai:'hyundai/002C5F'};
// SVG assets supplied by Simple Icons CDN. Replace with approved manufacturer logo files before production.
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
let selected='',expanded=false;
function makeButton(name){const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='brand'+(selected===name?' selected':'');b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(selected===name));const mark=document.createElement('span');mark.className='brand-logo';if(officialMarks[name]){const img=document.createElement('img');img.src='https://cdn.simpleicons.org/'+officialMarks[name];img.alt='';img.loading='lazy';img.addEventListener('error',()=>{mark.replaceChildren()});mark.append(img)}const t=document.createElement('span');t.textContent=name;b.append(mark,t);b.addEventListener('click',()=>{selected=name;$('selection').textContent='Selected: '+name;$('error').textContent='';$('search').value='';expanded=false;render();window.showVehicleStep(name)});return b}
function render(){
 const q=$('search').value.trim().toLowerCase();
 $('popular').replaceChildren(...popular.map(makeButton));
 $('allBrands').classList.toggle('open',expanded);
 $('search').setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(expanded));$('brandArrowToggle').setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(expanded));
 const found=brands.filter(b=>b.toLowerCase().includes(q));
 $('results').replaceChildren(...found.map(makeButton));
 if(!found.length){const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='empty';el.textContent='No matching car brand found';$('results').append(el)}
}
$('brandArrowToggle').addEventListener('click',()=>{expanded=!expanded;render();if(expanded)$('search').focus()});
$('search').addEventListener('focus',()=>{expanded=true;render()});
$('search').addEventListener('click',()=>{expanded=true;render()});
$('search').addEventListener('input',()=>{expanded=true;render()});
$('search').addEventListener('keydown',event=>{
 if(event.key==='ArrowDown'){expanded=true;render();event.preventDefault();const first=$('results').querySelector('button');if(first)first.focus()}
 if(event.key==='Escape'){expanded=false;render();$('search').blur()}
});
document.addEventListener('pointerdown',event=>{
 if(!event.target.closest('#brandPicker')){expanded=false;render()}
});
$('submit').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!selected){$('error').textContent='Please select your car brand to continue.';$('search').focus();return}window.showVehicleStep(selected)});$('close').addEventListener('click',()=>$('next').close());$('continue').addEventListener('click',()=>{$('next').close(); /* Replace with the next-stage model/year screen integration. */});render();
</script>
<section aria-label="Vehicle details" hidden="" id="vehicleStep">
<div class="step-shell">
<div class="step-head"><button class="step-back" id="backToBrands" type="button">← Back to car brands</button><span class="step-count">Step 2 of 4 · Vehicle details</span></div>
<div aria-label="Quote progress" class="step-track"><span></span></div>
<div class="vehicle-layout">
<aside class="vehicle-aside">
<span class="pill">POLICYHOUSE MOTOR INSURANCE</span>
<h1>Just a few details about your car.</h1>
<p>Tell us what you drive so we can help you find suitable comprehensive insurance options.</p>
<div class="vehicle-summary"><small>YOUR SELECTED MANUFACTURER</small><strong id="chosenBrand">Toyota</strong></div>
</aside>
<section aria-labelledby="detailsTitle" class="vehicle-form">
<h2 id="detailsTitle">Tell us about your vehicle</h2>
<p class="intro">This takes less than a minute to complete.</p>
<form id="vehicleDetailsForm" novalidate="">
<div class="vehicle-fields">
<div class="vehicle-field"><label for="vehicleMake">Car manufacturer</label><input id="vehicleMake" name="make" readonly=""/></div>
<div class="vehicle-field"><label for="vehicleModel">Car model</label><select id="vehicleModel" name="model" required=""><option value="">Select model</option></select><input id="customVehicleModel" type="text" placeholder="Enter your car model" aria-label="Enter your car model" maxlength="80" hidden style="margin-top:9px"></div>
<div class="vehicle-field"><label for="vehicleYear">Manufacturing year</label><select id="vehicleYear" name="year" required=""><option value="">Select year</option></select></div>
<div class="vehicle-field"><label for="vehicleEmirate" id="emirateFieldLabel">Registration emirate</label><select id="vehicleEmirate" name="emirate" required=""><option value="">Select emirate</option><option>Abu Dhabi</option><option>Dubai</option><option>Sharjah</option><option>Ajman</option><option>Umm Al Quwain</option><option>Ras Al Khaimah</option><option>Fujairah</option></select></div>
<div class="vehicle-choice"><fieldset><legend>Is this a new or existing vehicle?</legend><div class="choice-row"><label><input name="ownership" required="" type="radio" value="New vehicle"/> New vehicle</label><label><input name="ownership" required="" type="radio" value="Existing vehicle"/> Existing vehicle</label></div></fieldset></div>
<div class="vehicle-conditional" hidden="" id="newVehicleFields">
<h3>New vehicle details</h3><p class="hint">A few details to help us prepare your new-car insurance enquiry.</p>
<div class="vehicle-conditional-grid">
<div class="vehicle-field full"><label for="newRegistration">Is your new car already registered? *</label><select data-conditional-required="true" id="newRegistration" name="new_registration"><option value="">Select registration status</option><option value="Yes">Yes, already registered</option><option value="No">No, not yet registered</option></select></div>
<div class="vehicle-field"><label for="purchaseValue">Vehicle purchase value (AED) *</label><input data-conditional-required="true" id="purchaseValue" min="1" name="purchase_value_aed" placeholder="e.g. 85000" step="1" type="number"/></div>
<div class="vehicle-field"><label for="newSpecification">Vehicle specification *</label><select data-conditional-required="true" id="newSpecification" name="vehicle_specification"><option value="">Select specification</option><option value="GCC">GCC</option><option value="Non-GCC">Other / Non-GCC</option><option value="Not sure">Not sure</option></select></div>
</div></div>
<div class="vehicle-conditional" hidden="" id="existingVehicleFields">
<h3>Existing vehicle details</h3><p class="hint">Tell us whether you are renewing your policy or looking to switch.</p>
<div class="vehicle-conditional-grid"><div class="vehicle-field full"><label for="existingInsuranceIntent">What would you like to do? *</label><select data-conditional-required="true" id="existingInsuranceIntent" name="insurance_intent"><option value="">Select an option</option><option value="Renew current policy">Renew my current policy</option><option value="Switch insurer">Switch to another insurer</option><option value="Need new insurance">Get insurance for an existing car</option></select></div>
<div class="vehicle-field full"><label for="existingExpiry">Current insurance expiry date (optional)</label><input id="existingExpiry" name="insurance_expiry" type="date"/></div></div></div></div>
<div class="vehicle-actions"><button type="submit">Continue to Your Details →</button><div aria-live="polite" class="vehicle-validation" id="vehicleValidation" role="status"></div><p class="vehicle-note">Your details are used only to prepare your insurance enquiry.</p></div>
</form>
</section>
</div>
</div>
</section>

   setOptions($('vehicleModel'),[...examples,'Other / Not listed'], 'Select model');
   $('customVehicleModel').hidden=true;$('customVehicleModel').required=false;$('customVehicleModel').value='';
   setOptions($('vehicleYear'),Array.from({length:32},(_,i)=>String(2027-i)),'Select year');
   $('vehicleValidation').textContent='';
   window.scrollTo(0,0);
 };
 $('vehicleModel').addEventListener('change',()=>{const other=$('vehicleModel').value==='Other / Not listed';
   const custom=$('customVehicleModel');
   custom.hidden=!other;
   custom.required=other;
   if(!other)custom.value='';
   if(other)custom.focus();});
 $('backToBrands').addEventListener('click',()=>{second.hidden=true;first.hidden=false;window.scrollTo(0,0)});
 $('vehicleDetailsForm').addEventListener('submit',e=>{
   e.preventDefault();
   const form=e.currentTarget;
   if(!form.checkValidity()){ $('vehicleValidation').textContent='Please complete all vehicle details to continue.';form.reportValidity();return;}
   const values=Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form).entries());
   if(values.model==='Other / Not listed')values.model=$('customVehicleModel').value.trim();
   $('vehicleValidation').style.color='#2E2D74';
   $('vehicleValidation').textContent='';
   window.policyhouseVehicleDetails=values;window.showContactStep(values);
 });
})();
</script>
<section aria-label="Contact details" hidden="" id="contactStep">
<div class="step-shell">
<div class="step-head"><button class="step-back" id="backToVehicle" type="button">← Back to vehicle details</button><span class="step-count">Step 3 of 4 · Your details</span></div>
<div aria-label="Quote progress" class="step-track"><span style="width:75%"></span></div>
<div class="contact-layout">
<aside class="contact-aside"><span class="pill">ALMOST THERE</span><h1>Your car is sorted. Let's find your cover.</h1><p>Share your contact details so a PolicyHouse advisor can help you explore suitable motor insurance options.</p><div class="contact-summary"><small>YOUR VEHICLE</small><strong id="contactVehicleSummary">—</strong><small style="margin-top:12px">Registration emirate</small><strong id="contactEmirateSummary">—</strong></div></aside>

<div class="contact-field"><label for="leadPhone">UAE mobile number *</label><div class="phone-group"><span class="phone-code">+971</span><input autocomplete="tel-national" id="leadPhone" inputmode="tel" maxlength="9" name="mobile" pattern="5[0-9]{8}" placeholder="5XXXXXXXX" required=""/></div></div>
<div class="contact-field"><label for="leadEmail">Email address *</label><input autocomplete="email" id="leadEmail" name="email" placeholder="you@example.com" required="" type="email"/></div>
<div class="cover-choice"><fieldset><legend>Which insurance cover are you interested in?</legend><div class="cover-row"><label><input checked="" name="cover_type" type="radio" value="Comprehensive"/> Comprehensive</label><label><input name="cover_type" type="radio" value="Third Party"/> Third Party</label></div></fieldset></div>
</div><label class="consent"><input id="leadConsent" name="contact_consent" required="" type="checkbox"/><span>I agree that PolicyHouse may contact me by phone, WhatsApp or email regarding this insurance enquiry, subject to its applicable privacy policy. *</span></label>
<button class="contact-submit" type="submit">Request My Quote →</button><p aria-live="polite" class="contact-error" id="contactError" role="status"></p><p class="contact-small">No payment required at this stage.</p></form>
<div class="contact-success" hidden="" id="contactSuccess" role="status"></div>
</div></div></div></section>
<script id="contactStepScript">
(function(){
 const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
 window.showContactStep=function(data){
   if(!data)return;
   $('vehicleStep').hidden=true;$('contactStep').hidden=false;
   $('contactVehicleSummary').textContent=[data.make,data.model,data.year,data.ownership].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
   $('contactEmirateSummary').textContent=data.emirate||'—';
   $('contactError').textContent='';
   window.scrollTo(0,0);
 };
 $('backToVehicle').addEventListener('click',()=>{$('contactStep').hidden=true;$('vehicleStep').hidden=false;window.scrollTo(0,0)});
 $('contactForm').addEventListener('submit',function(e){
   e.preventDefault();
   if(!this.checkValidity()){$('contactError').textContent='Please complete the required fields and confirm your consent.';this.reportValidity();return;}
   const contact=Object.fromEntries(new FormData(this).entries());
   window.showReviewStep(contact);
 });
})();
</script>

0;border:0;background:transparent;color:#2E2D74;text-decoration:underline;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700" type="button">Review again</button></div></div></div></div></section><script id="reviewStepScript">(function(){const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);let contactDraft={};function displayRows(id,rows){const el=$(id);el.replaceChildren();rows.forEach(([label,value])=>{const cell=document.createElement('div');cell.className='review-cell';const k=document.createElement('small');k.textContent=label;const v=document.createElement('b');v.textContent=value||'—';cell.append(k,v);el.append(cell)})}window.showReviewStep=function(contact){contactDraft={...contact};const car=window.policyhouseVehicleDetails||{};$('contactStep').hidden=true;$('reviewStep').hidden=false;$('reviewContent').hidden=false;$('reviewResult').hidden=true;displayRows('reviewVehicleRows',[['Manufacturer',car.make],['Model',car.model],['Manufacturing year',car.year],['Registration emirate',car.emirate],['Vehicle status',car.ownership],...(car.ownership==='New vehicle'?[['Registration status',car.new_registration==='No'?'Not yet registered':car.new_registration],['Purchase value (AED)',car.purchase_value_aed?Number(car.purchase_value_aed).toLocaleString('en-AE'):'—'],['Vehicle specification',car.vehicle_specification]]:[['Insurance requirement',car.insurance_intent],['Policy expiry date',car.insurance_expiry||'Not provided']])]);displayRows('reviewContactRows',[['Full name',contact.full_name],['Mobile','+971 '+(contact.mobile||'')],['Email',contact.email],['Cover type',contact.cover_type]]);window.scrollTo(0,0)};function toContact(){$('reviewStep').hidden=true;$('contactStep').hidden=false;$('contactForm').hidden=false;$('contactSuccess').hidden=true;window.scrollTo(0,0)}$('backToContact').addEventListener('click',toContact);$('editContact').addEventListener('click',toContact);$('editVehicle').addEventListener('click',()=>{$('reviewStep').hidden=true;$('vehicleStep').hidden=false;window.scrollTo(0,0)});$('confirmRequest').addEventListener('click',()=>{$('reviewContent').hidden=true;$('reviewResult').hidden=false});$('editAfterConfirm').addEventListener('click',()=>{$('reviewResult').hidden=true;$('reviewContent').hidden=false});$('finalGetQuote').addEventListener('click',()=>{$('finalGetQuote').hidden=true;$('finalQuoteStatus').hidden=true;$('editAfterConfirm').hidden=true;const result=$('reviewResult');result.querySelector('h3').hidden=true;result.querySelector('p').hidden=true;$('quoteConfirmation').hidden=false;window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});});$('restartQuote').addEventListener('click',()=>{window.location.reload()});})();</script><script id="vehicleConditionalScript">
(function(){
const form=document.getElementById('vehicleDetailsForm');
const newBox=document.getElementById('newVehicleFields');
const existingBox=document.getElementById('existingVehicleFields');
const emirateLabel=document.getElementById('emirateFieldLabel');
function updateConditionalFields(){
 const choice=form.querySelector('input[name="ownership"]:checked')?.value;
 newBox.hidden=choice!=='New vehicle';existingBox.hidden=choice!=='Existing vehicle';
 for(const box of [newBox,existingBox]){
   for(const field of box.querySelectorAll('input,select')){
     field.disabled=box.hidden;
     field.required=!box.hidden && field.dataset.conditionalRequired==='true';
   }
 }
 emirateLabel.textContent=choice==='New vehicle'?'Registration emirate (or planned emirate)':'Registration emirate';
}
form.querySelectorAll('input[name="ownership"]').forEach(r=>r.addEventListener('change',updateConditionalFields));
updateConditionalFields();
})();
</script></body></html>
